title: A flat finitely presented local homomorphism with m_R S = m_S and finite separable residue extension is etale
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a local homomorphism of local rings $(R,\mathfrak m_R,\kappa_R)$, $(S,\mathfrak m_S,\kappa_S)$ such that (1) $S$ is a finitely presented $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]; (2) $R\to S$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]; (3) $\mathfrak m_RS=\mathfrak m_S$; (4) the field extension $\kappa_S/\kappa_R$ is finite and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Then $R\to S$ is an étale ring map, that is, $H_1(L_{S/R})=0$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and $\Omega_{S/R}=0$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] (equivalently [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-map-iff-etale-affine], $\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is étale).

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00U6 (lemma-characterize-etale, line 39470), the case of a local homomorphism of local rings with q = m_S: then R_p -> S_q is R -> S, and 'etale at q' (S_g etale over R for some g not in q) gives S etale over R since g is a unit of S
